_about: The words of grateful.gg/agents. Change them here, then run: python3 -I _tools/build_agents_page.py. No em or en dashes, no prices. Every tool in tools.json needs a line, an ask and a call here, or the build stops.

meta.title: The Oasis for AI agents
meta.description: One MCP address, {count} tools with an example each, and a public events feed, for any agent that plans and runs events.
meta.card_alt: Agents propose. People approve. The Oasis by Grateful Giraffes.

hero.title: Agents propose. People approve.
hero.lede: The Oasis is where Grateful Giraffes hosts plan and run events. Connect your own AI over MCP and it can draft the event, build the page, keep the guest list and write the emails. Going live and emailing guests wait for your yes.

connect.title: Connect your agent
connect.intro: One address for every agent. Paste it once, sign in to the Oasis, and click Allow. Your agent then acts as you: it can do what you can do on the site, never more.

clients.name: Claude
steps: Open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector.
Paste the address and sign in to the Oasis.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.code: claude mcp add -s user --transport http the-oasis https://app.grateful.gg/claude/mcp
steps: Run this once in a terminal.
Then type /mcp in Claude Code and choose Authenticate.

approval.title: What waits for a yes
approval.intro: An agent on the Oasis works the way a good assistant does: it prepares, you decide.
lines: A new event is a draft
RSVPs stay closed until its host has seen the page and said yes.
An email is a preview first
The agent shows the exact words and how many people get it. It sends only after the host says yes.
A share card is drawn before it is saved
And a new opening image goes on the page only once the host picks it.
Edits to a page you host are live right away
Each one is noted, and the Grateful Giraffes team gets a summary.
Your agent is you, never more
It can do what you can do on the site. Every call is logged, up to 60 a minute.
A street address goes to confirmed guests only. Public pages give the city.

open.title: Open data, no sign-in
open.intro: What any agent can read before anyone connects.
items: Upcoming public events as JSON: name, link, start and end, city, and whether RSVPs are open.
A short guide for language models: what the Oasis is and where everything lives.
Every public event page carries schema.org Event data.

tools_section.title: Every tool, with an example
tools_section.intro: What your agent can do once you connect. Each tool shows something you might say and the call your agent makes.

groups.title: Pages you host
groups.intro: Read a page, then change its words, sections, photos and look.

groups.title: New events
groups.intro: For approved hosts. A new event stays a draft until you publish it.

groups.title: Your own page design
groups.intro: Bring a page made anywhere. The Oasis RSVP stays pinned on it.

groups.title: Guests
groups.intro: The guest list, the door and emails to guests.

groups.title: Design ideas
groups.intro: Propose an improvement to the Oasis itself.

list_my_events.line: The events you host and the landing pages you can edit, with their links.

get_page.line: Everything on a page that can change: each section's words, its photos, the sections you added and the run of show.
get_page.ask: Read me what's on the Sunday Supper page.

update_page.line: Change the words of a page's sections. Only the fields you name change.

add_section.line: Add a section of your own: a photo with a heading, a headline, a paragraph and a hosted-by line. Up to six.
add_section.ask: Add a section about the music after the gathering section.

call.title: Three guitars and a cello
call.body: Live, unplugged, and close enough to feel.

update_section.line: Change a section you added: its words, its place on the page or its photo.

remove_section.line: Remove a section you added. Anything after it moves up.

set_photo.line: Give a section a new photo from a direct link, or go back to the one it had.
set_photo.ask: Use this photo for the opening.

update_style.line: Change how the page looks: colours, fonts, the order of sections, button labels and the layout.
update_style.ask: Switch to the ocean palette and fit it on one screen.

set_share.line: Make the share card people see when the event's grateful.gg link is sent. It can be drawn as a preview before it is saved.
set_share.ask: Show me a share card before you save it.

update_event.line: Change the event itself: its name, place line, who needs approval, the guest limit, the waitlist and the run of show.
update_event.ask: Cap it at 40 guests and let me approve every request.

create_event.line: Start a new event page as a draft, with RSVPs closed until you publish it.
create_event.ask: Start a potluck in Venice on Sunday the 22nd at noon.

gathering.title: Bring a dish, meet a neighbour
gathering.body: Long tables, good food, new friends.

make_art.line: Make four versions of the opening image from a description.
make_art.ask: Picture a long table under string lights at dusk.

call.description: A long table under string lights at dusk, warm and painted

change_art.line: Take your note on one image and make four new takes of it.
change_art.ask: On the second one, make the sky more pink.

show_art.line: Show the newest four images again, and which one is on the page.
show_art.ask: Show me the four images again.

choose_art.line: Put the image you picked on the page as its opening, sized for phones and computers.

publish_event.line: Put a new event live: RSVPs open and its grateful.gg share link is made. Only after you have seen the draft and said yes.

upload_event_page.line: Replace the event's page with one of your own design. It is saved as a draft with a preview link.
upload_event_page.ask: Use the page I just designed.

get_event_page.line: Read the page you uploaded, to revise it: the waiting draft if there is one, else the live page.
get_event_page.ask: What is in my uploaded page right now?

add_page_asset.line: Keep a picture or video from a link that would expire, so your page can use it for good.
add_page_asset.ask: Keep this image so the link never breaks.

publish_event_page.line: Put your uploaded page live, after you have looked at the preview and said yes.

remove_event_page.line: Take your uploaded page down and show the event's Oasis page again. Your uploads are kept.
remove_event_page.ask: Go back to the Oasis page.

list_guests.line: Who is coming, as the host panel shows it: name, status and party size.

add_guests.line: Add people straight to Going, up to 100 at a time. Each one gets the confirmation email unless you say not to.
add_guests.ask: Add Sam and Priya, no emails yet.

check_in.line: Check a guest in at the door, the whole party or some of it.
check_in.ask: Sam's party of two just arrived.

call.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Sam

remove_guest.line: Take a guest off the list quietly. No email goes to them and their seat is freed.

call.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Priya

restore_guest.line: Put back a guest a host removed.

call.guest_id: the id list_guests gave for Priya

message_guests.line: Email the guests, signed by the hosts. It previews first and sends only after you say yes.
message_guests.ask: Draft a note to everyone going about parking.

call.subject: Parking on Sunday
call.message: Street parking is easiest on Rose Avenue. See you at noon.

get_design_system.line: Read the Oasis design brief before proposing a change to the Oasis itself.
get_design_system.ask: What are the Oasis design rules?

submit_design_idea.line: Send the Grateful Giraffes team a design idea, with a mockup if you have one.
submit_design_idea.ask: Send the team my idea for the RSVP button.

call.title: Keep RSVP in reach on phones
call.problem: On a small phone the RSVP button sits below the first screen.
call.proposal: Pin it to the bottom of the screen.

list_my_design_ideas.line: See the ideas you sent and what the team answered.
list_my_design_ideas.ask: Did the team answer my idea?

footer.line: The Oasis is the home of Grateful Giraffes, a community you co-own.
